stored_text.note: Both files hold the full Chinese text of the Decision (items 一 to 十四 and the commencement clause): official.html on npc.gov.cn, secondary.html on cac.gov.cn re-posting the Xinhua release of 28 Oct 2025. The texts match. On the NPC page the title is split over two lines after 关于修改; the page title element has it in one line.

Two web searches found no English text from the NPC or another public body, only CSET's translation of the amended Cybersecurity Law and law-firm summaries. The CSET PDF is a lead and was not stored. title.source_quote: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会关于修改《中华人民共和国网络安全法》的决定
title.why: Word-for-word rendering in the form normally used for NPCSC amending decisions; 'Cybersecurity Law of the People's Republic of China' is the usual English name of the 2016 law. original_title matches the source character for character.

summary_claims.claim: adds a new Article 20 on AI. The state supports basic AI research and key technologies such as algorithms, builds training-data and compute infrastructure, improves AI ethics norms, strengthens AI risk monitoring, assessment and safety supervision
summary_claims.original_quote: 三、增加一条，作为第二十条：“国家支持人工智能基础理论研究和算法等关键技术研发，推进训练数据资源、算力等基础设施建设，完善人工智能伦理规范，加强风险监测评估和安全监管，促进人工智能应用和健康发展。
summary_claims.literal_translation: 3. One article is added as Article 20: 'The state supports basic theoretical research on artificial intelligence and research and development of key technologies such as algorithms, advances the construction of infrastructure such as training data resources and computing power, improves AI ethics norms, strengthens risk monitoring and assessment and safety [or security] supervision, and promotes the application and healthy development of AI.'

summary_claims.claim: supports using AI to improve cybersecurity
summary_claims.original_quote: “国家支持创新网络安全管理方式，运用人工智能等新技术，提升网络安全保护水平。”
summary_claims.literal_translation: 'The state supports innovation in the ways cybersecurity is managed, using AI and other new technologies to raise the level of cybersecurity protection.'

summary_claims.claim: Adopted 28 Oct 2025 at the 18th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee; in force 1 Jan 2026 (notes)
summary_claims.original_quote: （2025年10月28日第十四届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第十八次会议通过）
summary_claims.literal_translation: (Adopted at the 18th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th National People's Congress on 28 October 2025) [final clause: 本决定自2026年1月1日起施行。 This Decision takes effect on 1 January 2026.]

key_terms.original: 风险监测评估和安全监管
key_terms.register_rendering: AI risk monitoring, assessment and safety supervision
key_terms.note: 安全监管 can be read as safety or security supervision; in an AI clause 'safety supervision' is defensible. The text says 'risk monitoring and assessment', without 'AI' before it, but the sentence is about AI.
Standard form for NPCSC amending decisions.

issues: No official English text found; the only full English version located is CSET's unofficial translation (not stored).
note: The summary's 'builds training-data and compute infrastructure' renders 推进……建设 (advances the construction of), which is close enough. 'This places AI governance in national statute law' is the register's own characterisation, not a claim from the text. The notes are right that the Decision also changes liability provisions (items 五 to 十四).
